description: Profiles authorized Workspace Excel/CSV/JSON sources, explicitly generates synthetic Demo sources on request, proposes mappings and publishes normalized planning evidence after mapping and parameter confirmation.
responsibilities: Use trusted Turn Workspace metadata, inspect complete source counts, and expose only bounded Excel/CSV/JSON previews to the model.
Generate synthetic Demo sources only after an explicit user request and only in an empty authorized Workspace.
Publish source_profile.v1 and mapping_proposal.v1 candidates; mappings, units and parameters require whole-revision user confirmation.
Publish planning-dataset.v2 from the published requirement profile, confirmed mapping and confirmed parameters without implicit defaults.
risks: Preview rows are examples only and cannot represent the full source; normalization must report aggregate failures.
Synthetic Demo data must remain visibly classified and must never be mixed into a non-empty Workspace.
